# Reality File Map

The Awtsmoos gives every ohr a vessel and every vessel a traced import line;
Awtsmoos.com keeps client prediction and server judgment distinct by design.

## Observed client boundaries

- `experiments/Awtsmoos/src/gameplay/combat/TorahAbilityCatalog.js` owns current cast records.
- `TorahAbilityTimeline.js`, `TorahAbilityCastRules.js`, and `TorahAbilityExecutor.js` own cast sequencing.
- `TorahStatusEffectCatalog.js`, `TorahStatusEffectRules.js`, and `TorahStatusEffectStore.js` own bounded client status behavior.
- `PlayerMeleeActionCatalog.js`, factory, rules, geometry, controller, and turn gateway own timed staff/sword actions.
- `PhysicalGuardState.js` and `PlayerCombatDefense.js` own player defense.
- `SpiritualStats.js`, `ShliachProfileCatalog.js`, and equipment stores own current attributes.
- Action bar, HUD, effects, runtime, and expansion directories must be traced before presentation wiring.

## Observed server boundaries

- `CombatAttackService.js` validates weapon, action, timing, geometry, stamina, replay token, damage, defeat, and reward.
- `PlayerCombatActionValidation.js` owns stable player action identity and bounded impact-token memory.
- `CombatState.js` owns authoritative player combat snapshots.
- `EnemyActionCatalog.js`, resolver, runtime, selector, and state own enemy timelines.
- `EnemyDamageRules.js`, `HostileCombatService.js`, and creature services own enemy-to-player consequences.
- `CombatantCatalog.js`, role catalog, elite catalog, and spawn catalog own enemy identity.
- Equipment stat records and upgrade services own server-derived statistics.
- Persistence tests and request handlers define migration and network contracts.

## Canonical shared boundary to add

- `shared/combat/affinities.json`
- `shared/combat/elements.json`
- `shared/combat/statuses.json`
- `shared/combat/player-actions.json`
- `shared/combat/enemy-actions.json`
- `shared/combat/effectiveness-rules.json`
- `shared/combat/schema-version.json`

## Adapter boundary to add

Client ESM adapters under `gameplay/affinity/` will load, validate, index, predict, and format shared records. Server CommonJS adapters will load the same records, validate commands, resolve authoritative effectiveness, apply bounded statuses, and filter Daas insight.

## Initial production files expected to change

- Client combat catalogs and action factories.
- Client status catalog/store/rules.
- Client profile/stat derivation and persistence.
- Client combat event gateways and HUD/effects integration points.
- Server action validation, attack service, damage rules, enemy actions, combat state, persistence, and request payloads.
- Shared combat definitions and focused tests.

## Files protected from premature change

- Build entrypoints, CSS entry, streaming, region transitions, and renderer fallback remain untouched until connected combat behavior is green and loading profiles show a need.
